programme.title: Union SG vs Lech Poznań - UEFA Europa League 2026/2027 - MD 5
programme.desc: Salzburg’s only previous encounter with an Armenian side came in the 2008-09 UEFA Cup qualifying phase, winning 7-0 at home and 3-0 away at Urartu. Armenian teams have lost all five previous European games against Austrian opponents by an aggregate score of 16-0.

programme.title: OFI Crete vs Anderlecht - UEFA Europa League 2026/2027 - MD 5
programme.desc: Crystal Palace’s only previous European meeting with a Spanish side came in the 2025-26 Conference League final, when they won 1-0 against Rayo Vallecano. Real Sociedad have just one win in 11 European games against English teams, winning 1-0 away at Manchester United in September 2022.
